description: This Java class manages SNMP transport balancing by handling service list changes, recalculating partitions, and determining if an entity is managed by the current transport node.

classes.name: SnmpTransportBalancingService
classes.description: Service class for balancing SNMP transports, handling service list changes, and partition calculations.

methods.name: onServiceListChanged
methods.description: Handles service list change events and triggers partition recalculation.

methods.name: isManagedByCurrentTransport
methods.description: Checks if a given entity is managed by the current SNMP transport node.

methods.name: resolvePartitionIndexForEntity
methods.description: Resolves the partition index for a specific entity ID.

methods.name: recalculatePartitions
methods.description: Recalculates the list of SNMP transports and updates partition indices, publishing an event if changed.
